analysis.week_summary: Christmas audio is back in force (Mariah Carey, Ariana Grande, Kelly Clarkson are all 'Returning'), while Tate McRae's 'Housewife' leads both Reels and the Irish Spotify chart. Expect festive and 'booking now open' content to dominate feeds until mid-December, so early, original seasonal content will stand out.
key_takeaways: 'Housewife' is the #1 Reels sound AND #1 on Spotify Ireland — the strongest crossover signal this week.
Holiday countdown and launch-reveal formats are peaking: this is the window for Christmas offers, vouchers and gift guides.
Most trending songs are major-label and may be blocked for Business accounts — plan original audio or voiceover versions of the same formats.
analysis.ireland_signal: Two Reels sounds also chart in Ireland: 'Housewife' (Tate McRae, #1, unchanged) and 'Nicole Kidman' (ADÉLA, #12, up 12). Irish acts Fontaines D.C. and Kingfishr hold several top-20 spots, which makes them a natural fit for local, Irish-pride content.

Education.headline: Quick-tip and 'study with me' formats over instrumentals are the safest win for education brands.
Education.content_idea: A 15-second 'One skill you can learn before Christmas' tip with text on screen, ending in a course or bootcamp CTA.
sample_copies: One skill. Six weeks. A new career path. 🎓 Start before January and walk into 2027 ahead. Link in bio to save your seat.
Studying in Limerick? Here's the 3-step method our students use to stay on track during exam season 📚 Save this for later!
video_formats: Reel: talking-head tip with on-screen text over an instrumental (15–20s)
Carousel: '5 skills to learn before 2027' with a save CTA on the last slide
Story: poll — 'What do you want to learn next?'

Business & Marketing.headline: 'How it started vs. how it's going' growth montages are rising: perfect for founders and agencies.

Business & Marketing.suggested_audio: What You Waiting For? — Gwen Stefani (Take a Chance Growth Montage)
sample_copies: From 0 bookings to a full December calendar 📈 Here's exactly what we changed. Want the same plan? DM 'PLAN'.
Your Christmas campaign should start now, not on 20 December. 3 posts to schedule this week 👇

Tech & AI.headline: Dramatic 'reveal' edits work well for showcasing AI tools and automations.
Tech & AI.content_idea: Screen-record a 3-hour task done in 3 minutes with AI, with the reveal on the drop.
sample_copies: This used to take me 3 hours every Monday. Now it takes 3 minutes 🤖 Comment 'AI' and I'll send you the workflow.
5 free AI tools every small business in Ireland should try before 2027 ⚡ Save this post.
video_formats: Reel: screen-recorded task, 'before AI vs after AI' reveal
Carousel: 5 free AI tools with one-line use cases
